reason: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:72-80, prisma.credential.update only updates `key: keys` and never resets `invalid: false` (likewise OAuth refresh updates such as packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:98-101 only update `key`). Because invalid credentials are skipped for availability checks in packages/core/getCalendarsEvents.ts:14-17 and flagged in the UI, a previously invalidated credential remains permanently marked invalid even after fresh keys are synced.
